SELECT
    tt.ticketid, tt.ticket_no, tt.title, tt.status, tt.solution,
    COALESCE(acc.accountname,'') AS empresa,
    CONCAT(COALESCE(cont.firstname,''),' ',COALESCE(cont.lastname,'')) AS cliente_asignado,
    CONCAT(COALESCE(u.first_name,''),' ',COALESCE(u.last_name,'')) AS tecnico_asignado,
    tt.parent_id AS account_id,
    COALESCE(tt.priority,'') AS priority,
    COALESCE(tt.category,'') AS category,
    crm.createdtime,
    crm.modifiedtime,
    NULL AS closedtime,
    COALESCE(crm.description,'') AS description,
    CONCAT(COALESCE(cont.firstname,''),' ',COALESCE(cont.lastname,'')) AS contacto,
    'false' AS deleted
  FROM vtiger_troubletickets tt
  JOIN vtiger_crmentity crm ON tt.ticketid = crm.crmid AND crm.deleted = 0
  LEFT JOIN vtiger_account acc ON tt.parent_id = acc.accountid
  LEFT JOIN vtiger_contactdetails cont ON tt.contact_id = cont.contactid
  LEFT JOIN vtiger_users u ON crm.smownerid = u.id
  WHERE tt.status IN ('Open','In Progress','Wait For Response','Coordinado','Pendiente')

  UNION

  SELECT DISTINCT
    tt.ticketid, tt.ticket_no, tt.title, tt.status, tt.solution,
    COALESCE(acc.accountname,'') AS empresa,
    CONCAT(COALESCE(cont.firstname,''),' ',COALESCE(cont.lastname,'')) AS cliente_asignado,
    CONCAT(COALESCE(u.first_name,''),' ',COALESCE(u.last_name,'')) AS tecnico_asignado,
    tt.parent_id AS account_id,
    COALESCE(tt.priority,'') AS priority,
    COALESCE(tt.category,'') AS category,
    crm.createdtime,
    crm.modifiedtime,
    CASE WHEN tt.status IN ('Closed','Resolved','Resuelto','Cerrado/Para Entregar')
         THEN crm.modifiedtime ELSE NULL END AS closedtime,
    COALESCE(crm.description,'') AS description,
    CONCAT(COALESCE(cont.firstname,''),' ',COALESCE(cont.lastname,'')) AS contacto,
    CASE WHEN crm.deleted = 1 THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END AS deleted
  FROM vtiger_modtracker_basic mtb
  JOIN vtiger_troubletickets tt ON tt.ticketid = mtb.crmid
  JOIN vtiger_crmentity crm ON tt.ticketid = crm.crmid
  LEFT JOIN vtiger_account acc ON tt.parent_id = acc.accountid
  LEFT JOIN vtiger_contactdetails cont ON tt.contact_id = cont.contactid
  LEFT JOIN vtiger_users u ON crm.smownerid = u.id
  WHERE mtb.id >= (SELECT MAX(id) FROM vtiger_modtracker_basic) - 1500
    AND mtb.module = 'HelpDesk'
  ORDER BY modifiedtime DESC
  LIMIT 2000

SELECT
  cr.crmid AS entity_id,
  cr.module AS entity_module,
  cr.relcrmid AS related_id,
  cr.relmodule AS related_module
FROM vtiger_crmentityrel cr
WHERE
  (cr.module IN ('HelpDesk','Project','ProjectTask','Potentials','Quotes')
   AND cr.relmodule IN ('ServiceContracts','Potentials','Quotes','HelpDesk','Project'))
  OR
  (cr.relmodule IN ('HelpDesk','Project','ProjectTask','Potentials','Quotes')
   AND cr.module IN ('ServiceContracts','Potentials','Quotes','HelpDesk','Project'))
ORDER BY cr.crmid, cr.relcrmid
LIMIT 200000

SELECT
    mtb.id AS basic_id,
    mtb.crmid AS ticket_id,
    mtb.changedon,
    mtb.whodid AS changed_by,
    mtd.fieldname AS field_name,
    COALESCE(mtd.prevalue, '') AS prevalue,
    COALESCE(mtd.postvalue, '') AS postvalue
  FROM vtiger_modtracker_basic mtb
  JOIN vtiger_modtracker_detail mtd ON mtd.id = mtb.id
  WHERE mtb.id >= (SELECT MAX(id) FROM vtiger_modtracker_basic) - 1500
    AND mtb.module = 'HelpDesk'
    AND mtd.fieldname IN ('assigned_user_id', 'ticketstatus', 'ticketpriorities')
  ORDER BY mtb.changedon DESC
  LIMIT 5000

-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- PG Recompute Aggregates — versión fixed 2026-05-13
--
-- FIX deadlock root cause:
--   1. pg_try_advisory_xact_lock(429551) → solo 1 instancia corre a la vez;
--      las demás salen rápido sin bloquear (RETURN del DO block).
--   2. ORDER BY ticket_id en cada subselect → lock order determinístico.
--   3. WHERE … IS DISTINCT FROM en cada UPDATE → no escribe filas sin cambios,
--      corta el bloat (cada UPDATE re-escribía 10K filas; ahora ~50 típicas).
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

DO $do$
DECLARE
  got_lock boolean;
BEGIN
  got_lock := pg_try_advisory_xact_lock(429551);
  IF NOT got_lock THEN
    RAISE NOTICE 'PG Recompute Aggregates: otro recompute en curso, skipping';
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  -- 1) Aggregates desde modtracker eventos
  UPDATE msp_cache.cache_tickets t SET
    assigned_at        = sub.assigned_at,
    real_assigned_at   = sub.real_assigned_at,
    first_response_at  = sub.first_response_at,
    resolved_at        = sub.resolved_at,
    num_reasignaciones = sub.num_reasignaciones,
    num_status_changes = sub.num_status_changes
  FROM (
    SELECT
      ticket_id,
      MIN(CASE WHEN field_name = 'assigned_user_id' AND COALESCE(postvalue, '') <> '' THEN changedon END) AS assigned_at,
      MIN(CASE WHEN field_name = 'assigned_user_id' AND COALESCE(postvalue, '') NOT IN ('', '19') THEN changedon END) AS real_assigned_at,
      MIN(CASE WHEN field_name = 'ticketstatus' AND prevalue = 'Open' AND postvalue <> 'Open' THEN changedon END) AS first_response_at,
      MIN(CASE WHEN field_name = 'ticketstatus' AND postvalue IN ('Closed','Resolved','Resuelto','Cerrado/Para Entregar') THEN changedon END) AS resolved_at,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE field_name = 'assigned_user_id') AS num_reasignaciones,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE field_name = 'ticketstatus') AS num_status_changes
    FROM msp_cache.cache_ticket_eventos
    GROUP BY ticket_id
    ORDER BY ticket_id
  ) sub
  WHERE t.ticketid = sub.ticket_id
    AND (t.assigned_at        IS DISTINCT FROM sub.assigned_at
      OR t.real_assigned_at   IS DISTINCT FROM sub.real_assigned_at
      OR t.first_response_at  IS DISTINCT FROM sub.first_response_at
      OR t.resolved_at        IS DISTINCT FROM sub.resolved_at
      OR t.num_reasignaciones IS DISTINCT FROM sub.num_reasignaciones
      OR t.num_status_changes IS DISTINCT FROM sub.num_status_changes);

  -- 2) FS first_at
  UPDATE msp_cache.cache_tickets t SET fs_first_at = sub.fs_first
  FROM (
    SELECT er.entity_id AS ticket_id, MIN(f.createdtime) AS fs_first
    FROM msp_cache.cache_entity_rel er
    JOIN msp_cache.cache_fs f ON f.fsid = er.related_id
    WHERE er.entity_module = 'HelpDesk' AND er.related_module = 'ServiceContracts'
    GROUP BY er.entity_id
    ORDER BY er.entity_id
  ) sub
  WHERE t.ticketid = sub.ticket_id
    AND t.fs_first_at IS DISTINCT FROM sub.fs_first;

  -- 3) Tiempos derivados (solo donde alguno de los inputs cambió)
  UPDATE msp_cache.cache_tickets SET
    tiempo_a_asignacion_h     = CASE WHEN assigned_at IS NOT NULL AND assigned_at >= createdtime
                                     THEN ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (assigned_at - createdtime))::numeric/3600, 2) END,
    tiempo_en_cr_h            = CASE WHEN real_assigned_at IS NOT NULL
                                     THEN ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (real_assigned_at - COALESCE(assigned_at, createdtime)))::numeric/3600, 2) END,
    tiempo_a_first_response_h = CASE WHEN first_response_at IS NOT NULL AND first_response_at >= createdtime
                                     THEN ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (first_response_at - createdtime))::numeric/3600, 2) END,
    tiempo_a_resolucion_h     = CASE WHEN resolved_at IS NOT NULL
                                     THEN ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (resolved_at - COALESCE(assigned_at, createdtime)))::numeric/3600, 2) END,
    tiempo_a_fs_h             = CASE WHEN fs_first_at IS NOT NULL
                                     THEN ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (fs_first_at - COALESCE(resolved_at, createdtime)))::numeric/3600, 2) END
  WHERE (assigned_at IS NOT NULL OR resolved_at IS NOT NULL OR fs_first_at IS NOT NULL)
    AND (
      tiempo_a_asignacion_h     IS DISTINCT FROM CASE WHEN assigned_at IS NOT NULL AND assigned_at >= createdtime
                                                       THEN ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (assigned_at - createdtime))::numeric/3600, 2) END
   OR tiempo_en_cr_h            IS DISTINCT FROM CASE WHEN real_assigned_at IS NOT NULL
                                                       THEN ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (real_assigned_at - COALESCE(assigned_at, createdtime)))::numeric/3600, 2) END
   OR tiempo_a_first_response_h IS DISTINCT FROM CASE WHEN first_response_at IS NOT NULL AND first_response_at >= createdtime
                                                       THEN ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (first_response_at - createdtime))::numeric/3600, 2) END
   OR tiempo_a_resolucion_h     IS DISTINCT FROM CASE WHEN resolved_at IS NOT NULL
                                                       THEN ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (resolved_at - COALESCE(assigned_at, createdtime)))::numeric/3600, 2) END
   OR tiempo_a_fs_h             IS DISTINCT FROM CASE WHEN fs_first_at IS NOT NULL
                                                       THEN ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (fs_first_at - COALESCE(resolved_at, createdtime)))::numeric/3600, 2) END
    );
END
$do$;
